summary: Validated backend POST /api/measurements/{revision_id}/unlock. 8/9 pytest cases PASS, 1 SKIPPED (estimate-referenced path documented as not-exercised per request note). Coverage: (1) Happy path — drove a draft through field_complete -> office_verified -> locked, confirmed GET shows status='locked' + is_immutable=true + locked_by/locked_at populated, then POST /unlock returned 200 with status='office_verified', is_immutable=false, locked_by/locked_at cleared; re-GET confirms persisted state. (2) Post-unlock usability — same revision was successfully transitioned back to 'draft' via POST /{id}/status, proving the immutable guard was lifted. (3) Guard: unlock on status='draft' -> 409 with detail 'Only a locked revision can be unlocked' and state unchanged. (4) Guard: unlock on status='field_complete' -> 409, state unchanged. (5) Guard: unlock on status='office_verified' -> 409, state unchanged (is_immutable stayed false). (6) Bogus revision id -> 404. (7) Role guard: sales user (sales1_38f545f9@example.com) received 403 on /unlock while revision remained locked; owner then unlocked it successfully. (8) Estimate-referenced 409 path — SKIPPED and clearly noted: requires takeoff template + estimate acceptance wiring not reachable in a small number of API calls; direct EstimateTakeoff insert requires valid estimate_id + template_revision_id FKs. Service code at services/measurements.py:611-613 performs the SELECT + 409 raise inline; the code path is present but was not exercised end-to-end. Frontend UI SKIPPED per request (SPA behind subscription/billing gate).
critical_code_review_comments: services/measurements.py unlock_revision (lines 604-619) correctly orders checks: 409 if !locked -> 403 if !VERIFY_ROLES -> 409 if EstimateTakeoff exists -> then mutate. Router (routers/measurements.py:96-101) additionally guards with require_roles(*MANAGE_ROLES), so non-MANAGE roles get 403 at the router before service code. Note: because router already gates by MANAGE_ROLES==VERIFY_ROLES, the service-level 403 branch (line 609-610) is effectively unreachable via HTTP — harmless defense-in-depth; keep for direct service callers.
log_action is called AFTER svc.unlock_revision returns and AFTER build_out on the mutated model; commit happens at request end. Correct.

unlock clears is_immutable, locked_by, locked_at, and sets status back to 'office_verified' (updated_at bumped). Does not touch verified_by/verified_at — correct: unlock preserves who verified the revision. Confirmed on GET after unlock.
EstimateTakeoff reference check uses .limit(1) — efficient. ondelete='RESTRICT' on measurement_revision_id at the FK level provides DB-level safety net.
